Name: FS Scrying Mirror
Author: G0th1cc80hdbvnny
Description:
This is my first official creation while i have another bigger project in progress! 


This reskin i made was based on a minor on and off fixation i have for the game At Dead Of Night, which changes the hand mirror for fashion sense into the scrying mirror from At Dead Of Night!


Fashion sense is of course required, and downloading this provides an image in which you just copy and paste into FashionSense\Framework\Assets and allow it to replace the hand mirror png, if there are any issues at all or suggestions feel free to let me know :)
enjoy <3

Downloads.Description: Just copy the image provided in this, paste it to 'FashionSense\Framework\Assets' and allow it to replace fashion sense's hand mirror png
